classification.difficultyReason: The completed first year models the percentage calculation and balance update. Students repeat this supplied process and use the explicit subtraction scaffold to find total interest.

content.prompt: $\$2400$ is invested at 6% p.a. compound interest for 3 years.

inlines.text: Complete the table to find the final value at the end of 3 years. Keep full precision in intermediate calculations and round the final value to 2 decimal places.
Each ending balance becomes the next starting balance. Interest = starting balance × 6%. Display amounts to cents and retain unrounded values in intermediate calculations.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}I&=2858.4384-2400\\I&=458.4384\end{align*}$$
The interest earned is $\$458.44$ to 2 decimal places. The completed scaffold is $\$2858.44$ − $\$2400$ = $\$458.44$.
